chart-ruler: Your chart ruler is the planet that rules your rising sign.
Taurus belongs to Venus, so Venus is her chart ruler.
Now look at where her Venus actually is.
It's in Taurus too, its own sign, which makes it steady and sure of itself.
And it's in the twelfth house, the most private part of a chart.
So the planet that speaks for Maya speaks quietly.
Comfort, loyalty and beauty really matter to her, and she tends to keep them close.
elements: Start by counting the planets in each element.
Maya has three in fire, three in earth, and four in water.
And in air, she has none.
Now, that doesn't mean she can't think or talk.
A missing element tends to be something you reach for, often in the people around you.
And Theo has planets in two air signs.
The chart they make together has three planets in Aquarius, which is an air sign too.
Six of Maya's planets are in cardinal signs, the ones that begin a season.
So she tends to be the one who initiates action.
patterns: Maya has three planets in Aries: the Sun, Mercury and Mars.
Three or more in one sign is called a stellium, and it concentrates the chart right there.
So who she is, how she thinks, and how she acts all run on Aries: direct, quick, and first to move.
But there's a second shape in her chart too.
Her Moon in Cancer is opposite Uranus and Neptune in Capricorn, half the circle away.
And her Sun in Aries is square to both ends, a quarter of the circle from each.
That's called a T-square, with the Sun at the apex.
Think of the opposition as a tug of war: the Moon's need for closeness and safety, against Uranus and Neptune's pull toward freedom and something larger.
The apex planet takes the pressure from both sides, and that's where the tension gets worked out.
For Maya, that's her Sun in Aries.
So she tends to settle the pull by acting, by striking out as herself.
All three corners are in cardinal signs, so this is a pattern that keeps her starting things.
Now, the point opposite the apex is empty, and astrologers read it as what the pattern is missing.
For Maya it falls late in Libra. Where Aries goes it alone, Libra meets someone halfway.
We'll come back to this point when we look at Maya's progressions next.
progressed-moon: In progressions, each day after your birth stands for one year of your life.
The progressed Moon moves the fastest, about a sign every two and a half years.
Right now, Maya's progressed Moon is in Libra, in her fifth house.
Libra is the sign of that empty point in her T-square, and her progressed Moon reaches the exact point in 2028.
So for these few years, the missing corner is filled in. Meeting someone halfway comes more easily, and the fifth house says it comes through play, romance, and making things.
The progressed Moon also runs a slow cycle with the progressed Sun, from new to full and back again, over about thirty years.
Your progressed lunar phase is where you are in that cycle.
It began in March 2024, and it runs to August 2027.
A cycle that opened with her progressed New Moon in 2016 is now in its building phase. It's a time for acting on what started back then.
synastry-aspects: Synastry lays one person's chart over the other's.
An aspect is the angle between two planets, and in synastry, it's one of your planets and one of theirs.
The closer an aspect is to its exact angle, the more strongly it tends to be felt.
That gap is called the orb, so the tightest aspects, the ones with the smallest orbs, come first.
Between Maya and Theo, the tightest one is her Moon trine his Pluto.
A trine is 120 degrees, a third of the circle, and it's the easy, flowing aspect.
And theirs is exact to the minute.
Her feelings meet his intensity without any strain. He isn't too much for her, and she can be fully felt by him.
The next one takes a little more care: her Neptune opposite his Mars, half a degree from exact.
An opposition is two planets facing each other across the circle.
Her Neptune tends to blur what his Mars is aiming at.
He pushes, she drifts or pictures something else, so plans are worth saying out loud.
Then there's her Jupiter on his Sun. That's a conjunction: two planets in the same place.
Her faith in him tends to make him more himself.
And her Moon sits right on his Ascendant and his Mars, both within a degree and a half.
She feels at home with how he comes across.
Her moods stir him to act, and his temper lands straight on her feelings.
house-overlays: Put one person's planets into the other person's houses, and you can see where each of you shows up in the other's life.
Theo's Mercury and Venus fall in Maya's seventh house, the house of partnership.
So his way of talking and loving lands right where she looks for a partner.
His Moon and Saturn fall in her tenth, the house of career and public standing.
He cares about what she's building, and he holds her to it.
Now let's go the other way.
Maya's Moon falls in Theo's first house, close to how he meets the world.
And her Sun and Mercury fall in his tenth.
These start to look like a consistent theme: each of them shows up in the other's public life.
cross-dispositors: Every sign has a ruling planet.
Mars rules Aries, Venus rules Taurus, the Moon rules Cancer, and so on around the wheel.
A planet in a sign answers to that sign's ruler, and that ruler is called its dispositor.
And you can follow that across two charts.
If your planet is in a sign that your partner's planet rules, then yours answers to theirs.
Maya's Sun, Mercury and Mars are all in Aries, so all three answer to Theo's Mars.
His Mars is in Cancer, so it answers to her Moon.
So her drive lands with his Mars, and his Mars takes its cue from her feelings.
What she starts, he tends to take up.
And how she feels sets the direction he acts in.
It runs the other way too.
Theo's Mercury and Venus are in Sagittarius, which is Jupiter's sign, so they answer to her Jupiter.
How he talks, and how he loves, both lean on her optimism.
Aspects show where two charts touch.
Dispositors show how each of you leans on the other, and what for.
composite-sun-moon: The composite chart is made from the midpoints of your two charts.
Maya and Theo's composite Sun is in Aquarius.
They come alive as friends. They like each other as much as they love each other.
It's in the eighth house, the house of intimacy and everything shared, so this is a friendship that runs on trust.
Their composite Moon is in Taurus.
Home, for the two of them, is the same good evening, again and again: the usual meal, the same side of the couch.
It's in the eleventh house, among friends and shared hopes.
So friendship shows up twice here, in the Aquarius Sun and in the eleventh house Moon.
And when a chart says something twice, astrologers take note.
composite-or-davison: The composite chart takes the midpoint of each pair of planets.
It's a combination of the two of you, not a chart built from a single time and place.
The Davison chart takes the moment and the place halfway between your two births.
For Maya and Theo, both charts give Gemini rising.
When two methods agree, that point carries more weight. This relationship meets the world curious and talking.
The composite Sun is in Aquarius, and the Davison Sun is in Leo, the opposite sign.
Opposite signs are two ends of one axis, and this one runs between belonging and standing out.
So the two charts agree on the theme, and stress different ends. The composite shows the friendship, and the Davison shows a relationship that also wants to shine.
Astrologers don't have to pick just one.
Many read the composite as the chart of the relationship, and bring in the Davison as a second view.
Overlay does the same, and it uses the Davison chart for progressions, because a real moment can be moved forward in time.
key-day: A key day is a day when something in the sky lands closely on your chart.
Maya and Theo's next shared one is January sixth.
That's the day Chiron stations direct.
After five months of moving backward through the zodiac, it stops and turns forward.
And a planet standing still is at its strongest.
Chiron marks the old sore spot, and the skill that grows from tending it.
It stops at 26 degrees of Aries.
That's square Maya's Uranus, her independent streak.
And it's sextile Saturn in the chart she and Theo share, the planet of their commitments.
So one event touches her chart, and the relationship's too.
For Maya, something tender about going her own way is close to the surface.
And for the two of them, the day tends to be good for a steady talk about what they've promised each other.
